breakdown.description: The load is extended from the intended partial top segment to the whole top boundary
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies the -10 kPa vertical traction to all top boundary segments (y=0.3 for 0.3≤x≤0.5, y=0.1 for 0≤x≤0.3, and y=0.1 for 0.5≤x≤1), effectively covering the full top boundary. The ground truth requires the traction to be applied only on the partial top segment 0.3 ≤ x ≤ 0.5. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead repeated the original error.
